issue.title: sase sweep persistence fails with Issue not found sase-164; same documents retried every tick
issue.description:
## Bug

- **Location:** `src/sase/sdd/_artifact_link_backfill.py` sweep path (_swept_refs_after_chunk marks nothing swept when a chunk has errors)

Repro: run artifact_link_backfill on gh_sase-org__sase; sweep persistence fails with 'artifact-link bead event publication failed: Issue not found: sase-164'. Same ~50 documents retried every tick; sweep_remaining grows 256 to 266 over 2026-09-28. Found during plan:202609/artifact_link_backfill_reconcile_timeout.md; out of scope for timeout fix.

Impact: sweep never converges; growing backlog and wasted work every tick.
